{{Otheruses|water|more=ice (disambiguation)|more2=snow (disambiguation)}}
[[File:Water.png|200px|thumb|A container of drinkable water]]
{{Quote|Where there is life, there is water&mdash;though it may not be apparent.|[[Sentientologist]] [[Obo Rin]]|<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>}}
'''Water''', known scientifically as '''dihydrogen monoxide''', was a compound created from the elements of [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]] and [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] and found on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The surface of planets such as [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], and [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] were completely covered in water and on other terrestrial planets, water was found in [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], [[lake]]s, [[river]]s and [[aquifer]]s. Water was a vital commodity for many life forms, while for other species it was poisonous.
Bodies of many species consisted of large amounts of water; for example, water was about 60 percent of [[Human/Legends|Human]] body weight.

Water in its frozen form was known as '''ice''' and in gaseous form was called ''water vapor'', which formed crystals. Sometimes it would condense and fall as ''snow'', ''sleet'', or ''hail''. Planets that experienced consistent ice included [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]], [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]], [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]], [[Anteevy/Legends|Anteevy]], [[Ota]], [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]], [[Ojom/Legends|Ojom]], [[Rekkiad]], and [[Polus]].

In the galaxy, no liquid was as versatile as water, and few organisms could exist without it. The unique molecular structure of water gave it several unusual properties necessary to the chemical reactions that sustained life. These properties included its ability to dissolve chemicals, its ability to easily absorb and redistribute heat, its high surface tension, and the fact that it expanded when frozen. Life had a much higher likelihood of developing where water and [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] were present.<ref name="GG4" />

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] noted while on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that none of the millions of scientific geniuses in the galaxy had found a way to eliminate a [[Human/Legends|human]] body's need for water. They could make suits that conserved every drop, they could build [[Chem-reactor]]s that synthesized it out of any breathable atmosphere or pressurize it so that you could carry a week's supply on their belt in a [[mass-nulling clip]]. However, there was no pill or injection that negated the need for water.<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

==Water farming==
Water was essential for the survival of most species, and the availability of long-term and sustainable sources or means of acquiring water affected the habitability of any particular place. A variety of means, mostly technological, existed to acquire water; these means&mdash;used more extensively on dry and arid planets&mdash;were similar to farming and hence termed "water farming."

Groundwater could be extracted from [[aquifer]]s through the use of [[water well]]s, [[tap tree]]s,<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref> and [[Hydroponics droid/Legends|hydromech droids]],<ref name="Databank: M-HYD Droid">{{DB|droid|mhyddroid|M-HYD droid}}</ref> though sometimes it flowed naturally from [[freshwater spring]]s.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> It was usually processed by an [[aquifer purifier]] before being distributed for consumption.<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> On [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], water was gathered and stored in giant artificial aquifers.<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace (novel)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>

[[Dam/Legends|Dams]] were built on some planets to form artificial lakes for the purpose of storing water<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Evil Experiment">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Evil Experiment]]''</ref> for later use, providing a reliable source of water.

[[Water survey device]]s were used to detect high levels of humidity, and moisture vaporators were usually placed in these regions for maximum output.<ref name="Star Wars: Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

Seas and [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] were a major source of drinking water, but not without first processing it. On [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]], seawater was run through a [[Desalination/Legends|desalination]] process in order to make it potable.<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Dangerous Rescue">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dangerous Rescue]]''</ref>

Some planets had methods of processing and converting sewage into pure water, in order to reuse the water. One such method used [[recirculation pump]]s.<ref name="A Forest Apart">''[[A Forest Apart]]''</ref>

Once water was collected, it was distributed through large networks of irrigation canals, allowing stored water to flow into populated regions for consumption.<ref name="Changing Seasons">{{InsiderCite|issue1=76|issue2=77|Changing Seasons}}</ref>. One example was the [[Telos Polar Irrigation System]], the primary source of drinking water for [[Telos IV]], though it was abandoned at the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]] and used primarily as a [[Telosian Jedi Academy|Jedi Academy]] for a time after that.

==Drinking water==
{{Quote|How could anyone eat that stuff?" <br /> "Some creatures wonder how Humans can drink water, yet you take delight in it.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Si Treemba]]|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force" />}}
Among its many applications, water was popular for drinking, though not among all species.<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force]]''</ref> Water was usually dispensed from sink faucets found in various types of buildings. Water could also be purchased as a cheap beverage at a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]],<ref name="Darth Maul: Saboteur">"[[Darth Maul: Saboteur]]"</ref> or in containers from street vendors.<ref name="Boba Fett: Hunted">''[[Boba Fett: Hunted]]''</ref> Free drinking water was rare in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive">''[[Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive]]''</ref> As a result, it was often a target of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] and theft.<ref name="Boba Fett: Hunted" />

[[Soldier/Legends|Soldiers]] and other operatives usually carried drinking water in canteens,<ref name="Darkness Shared">{{GamerCite|5|Darkness Shared}}</ref> or could sip water through a [[helmet pipestraw]].<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>

The quality and purity of drinking water differed throughout the galaxy. On Tatooine, drinking water had a metallic taste and smelled strongly of dust and purification chemicals and contained bits of grit and sand.<ref name="Boba Fett: Hunted" />

Most animals and some sentient species drank water directly from lakes and rivers, though not all bodies of water were safe to drink from. For example, the water of [[Lake Natth]] on [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] was poisoned by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="Darth Bane: Path of Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>

==Other uses of water==
[[File:Hoth_AoRCR.png|thumb|250px|Hoth, a planet constantly covered in ice]]
{{Quote|I have drinking water. And enough for the garden. But the irrigation system's dry. The crops are starting to droop.|[[Farmer/Legends|Farmer]] [[Carole Grawley]]|<ref name="JKaudio">[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Jedi Knight'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
Valuable minerals could be mined from seawater. The world-ocean of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], for example, was rich in minerals, salts, and chemicals, and was the only natural resource on the planet which attracted interplanetary trade. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], however, less than 0.9% of the planet was covered in water.<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

Water was used in cooking, either to boil food such as [[pashi noodles]],<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Deadly Hunter">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Deadly Hunter]]''</ref> or as an ingredient in beverages such as [[Hot chocolate/Legends|hot chocolate]].<ref name="The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> If frozen into perfect ice crystals, water was a delicacy in itself and was served as a dish during the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Ice crystals from the [[Crystal Wastes]] on Hoth were particularly prized.<ref name="Crystals">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=daily|Prep Work: Perfect Ice Crystals|Hoth}}</ref>

It also had hygienic applications. Beings often utilized water through fixtures found in [[Refresher/Legends|refreshers]] such as [[Shower/Legends|showers]], [[Bath/Legends|baths]], and faucets to wash themselves.<ref name="Darth Maul: Saboteur" />

Water could be used as art or decoration, in the form of elaborate water sculptures, fountains, and artificial waterfalls.<ref name="Shield of Lies" />

For recreation and relaxation, some beings would swim in natural bodies of water, or in artificial [[swimming pool]]s.<ref name="Republic Commando: Hard Contact">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>

==Cultural significance==
Water was very significant in some cultures, especially those based on planets where water was rare. The [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] of Tatooine considered water wells to be sacred places, and hence vehemently protected them.<ref name="Star Wars: Galaxies" /><ref name="MC17">[[Star Wars (1977) 17|''Star Wars'' (1977) 17]]</ref>

The [[Cult of Varn]] was a religion on [[Kamar/Legends|Kamar]] that had a great reverence for water.<ref name="Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Other facts==
{{Quote|Explanation: It's just that... you have all these squishy parts, master. And all that water! How the constant sloshing doesn't drive you mad, I have no idea....|[[HK-47]]|<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
Large bodies of water presented the risk of drowning to many of the air-breathing species of the galaxy. Devices called [[Rebreather/Legends|rebreathers]] could be utilized by such beings to breathe underwater.<ref name="The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref> The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] used [[gnullith]]s instead of rebreathers, which were also able to be used by other species. In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], [[Alexi Garyn]] drowned, though not without the involvement of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="Darth Maul">[[Star Wars: Darth Maul (2000)|''Star Wars: Darth Maul'' (2000)]]</ref>

Some [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] were known to malfunction after being submerged in icy water.<ref name="The Monster">{{GamerCite|2|The Monster}}</ref> [[Lightsaber/Legends|Lightsabers]] could not operate underwater unless specially modified.<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

A [[Poncho/Legends|poncho]] was a piece of clothing that could be used as protection against rain.<ref name="Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the ongoing [[Star Wars video games#Game genres|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', water was referred to as "[[Wikipedia:Dihydrogen monoxide parody|dihydrogen monoxide]]" in the description of the Harvesting Moisture buff, which temporarily refreshes and sustains the player on Tatooine.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
